examples.title: Example 1: Implementing a Simple Drop-down Menu Title Bar
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to implement a simple drop-down menu title bar with various configurations, including one with a back arrow and one with a right-side menu item list.

examples.title: Example 2: Implementing Screen Reader Announcement for the Custom Button on the Right Side
examples.description: This example customizes the screen reader announcement text by setting the accessibilityText, accessibilityDescription, and accessibilityLevel properties of the custom button on the right side of the title bar. This functionality is supported since API version 18.

examples.title: Example 3: Setting the Symbol Icon
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use symbolStyle in SelectTitleBarMenuItem to set custom symbol icons. This functionality is supported since API version 18.
